<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="description" content="Anay Ghosh is a UI/UX and visual designer creating thoughtful digital experiences.">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<title>Anay Ghosh – UI/UX & Visual Designer</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,300;12..96,500;12..96,800&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#08090D;--bg2:#101218;--el:#171A22;--tx:#F4F4F5;--tx2:#9296A2;--ac:#8B7CFF;--ac2:#63D9CE;--bd:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
--d:'Bricolage Grotesque','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--b:'Instrument Sans','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-padding-top:5rem;background:var(--bg)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:400 1.05rem/1.6 var(--b);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac2);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:4px}
section{padding:8rem 5vw;position:relative}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--d);margin:0;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:.95}
h2{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,7vw,6.5rem);max-width:14ch}
p{max-width:60ch;color:var(--tx2)}
.mut{color:var(--tx2)}
/* nav */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:calc(1.2rem + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 5vw 1.2rem;mix-blend-mode:normal}
.logo{font:800 1.1rem var(--d);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.links{display:flex;gap:2rem;position:relative}
.links a{padding:.3rem 0;color:var(--tx2);transition:color .3s}
.links a.on,.links a:hover{color:var(--tx)}
.ind{position:absolute;bottom:-4px;height:2px;background:var(--ac);border-radius:2px;transition:left .5s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1),width .5s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)}
.burger{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid var(--bd);color:var(--tx);border-radius:99px;padding:.5rem 1rem;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
body.scrolled nav{background:linear-gradient(var(--bg),transparent)}
/* hero */
#hero{padding-top:8rem;min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding-bottom:4rem;overflow:hidden}
#fx{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0}
.hero-in{position:relative;z-index:2}
.id{color:var(--tx2);margin:0 0 1.5rem}
.name{font:800 clamp(1.6rem,3.6vw,3rem) var(--d);letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--tx);margin:0 0 1.2rem}.name::after{content:"";display:block;width:3rem;height:3px;background:var(--ac2);margin-top:.8rem;border-radius:2px}
.hl{position:relative;font-size:clamp(2rem,5.4vw,5.4rem);max-width:17ch;line-height:1}
.hl .l2{position:absolute;inset:0;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px var(--ac2);pointer-events:none;
-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle 150px at var(--mx,-999px) var(--my,-999px),#000 0,#000 55%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle 150px at var(--mx,-999px) var(--my,-999px),#000 0,#000 55%,transparent 100%)}
.ch{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.w{display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap}
.sub{margin:2rem 0}
.row{display:flex;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:.9rem 1.6rem;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--bd);transition:background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
.btn.p{background:var(--tx);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--tx)}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--ac)}.btn.p:hover{background:var(--ac);border-color:var(--ac)}
.hint{position:absolute;right:5vw;bottom:4rem;z-index:2;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--tx2);max-width:22ch;text-align:right}
/* about */
#about{background:var(--bg2)}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5vw;margin-top:4rem}
.cols h3{font-size:1.3rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:.6rem;color:var(--tx)}
.cols div{border-top:1px solid var(--bd);padding-top:1.4rem}
.big{font:300 clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.4rem)/1.3 var(--d);color:var(--tx);max-width:28ch;margin-top:3rem;letter-spacing:-.02em}
/* works */
.stage-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.3fr);gap:4vw;margin-top:4rem;align-items:start}
.plist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
.plist button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:1.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);cursor:pointer;color:var(--tx2);transition:color .3s,padding .4s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)}
.plist button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac2);outline-offset:2px}
.plist .t{font:800 clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.6rem)/1 var(--d);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.plist .c{font-size:.9rem;text-align:right}
.plist button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--tx);padding-left:1.2rem}
.plist button[aria-selected=true] .t{color:var(--ac)}
.stage{perspective:1200px;position:sticky;top:6rem}
.card{position:relative;aspect-ratio:2.2/1;border-radius:6px;background:#06070b;border:1px solid var(--bd);overflow:hidden;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .25s ease-out}
.card .layer{position:absolute;inset:0;transition:transform .25s ease-out;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.art{position:absolute;inset:0;transition:opacity .6s,clip-path .8s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1);clip-path:circle(0% at 50% 50%);opacity:0}
.art.on{opacity:1;clip-path:circle(150% at 50% 50%)}
.art{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4%;padding:7%;background:#101218}
.bw{width:100%;height:100%;background:#0d0f15;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.bw .bar{height:10px;width:40%;background:var(--bd);border-radius:5px}.bw .bar+.bar{width:70%;height:18px;border-radius:9px}
.bw .gr{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.gr b{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--ac),#2a2e42);border-radius:6px;position:relative}.gr b:nth-child(2n){background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--ac2),#1f2a2e)}
.gr b::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:8%;bottom:10%;width:55%;height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.ph{width:32%;aspect-ratio:9/18;background:#0d0f15;border:2px solid #2a2e3d;border-radius:18px;padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}.ph+.ph{margin-top:14%}
.ph s{height:8px;width:50%;border-radius:4px;background:var(--bd)}.ph u{flex:1;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--ac),#2a2e42)}.ph u+u{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--ac2),#1f2a2e)}
.cb{width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}.cb i{height:28px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--el);width:55%;border:1px solid var(--bd)}.cb i:nth-child(2n){align-self:flex-end;background:var(--ac);width:45%;border-color:transparent}.cb i:nth-child(3){width:72%}
.lg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;width:100%;height:100%}.lg b{border-radius:8px;background:var(--el);display:grid;place-items:center}
.lg b::after{content:"";width:40%;aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--ac2);border-radius:50% 0 50% 0}.lg b:nth-child(2)::after{background:var(--ac);border-radius:50%}.lg b:nth-child(3)::after{border-radius:0;transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--tx)}.lg b:nth-child(4)::after{background:var(--ac);border-radius:0 50% 0 50%}.lg b:nth-child(5)::after{border-radius:50% 50% 0 0}.lg b:nth-child(6)::after{background:var(--tx);border-radius:50% 0}
.fs{display:flex;gap:8px;width:100%}.fs b{flex:1;aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:6px;background:var(--el);border:1px solid var(--bd);position:relative}.fs b::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:34%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac2);left:calc(10% + var(--n)*12%);top:calc(58% - var(--n)*13%)}.fs b:nth-child(2){--n:1}.fs b:nth-child(3){--n:2}.fs b:nth-child(4){--n:3}
.cap{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:8px;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--tx2)}
.sk li small{display:block;max-height:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.45;color:var(--tx2);transition:max-height .5s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1),opacity .4s,margin .4s}
.sk li:focus-visible small,.sk li.open small{max-height:6rem;opacity:1;margin-top:.4rem}
@media (hover:hover){.sk li:hover small{max-height:6rem;opacity:1;margin-top:.4rem}}
.soc a{color:var(--tx);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ac2)}.soc a:hover{color:var(--ac2)}
.meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1.5rem;margin-top:2rem}
.meta dt{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--tx2)}.meta dd{margin:.2rem 0 0;color:var(--tx)}
.pd{margin-top:1.5rem;min-height:3.2rem}
.case{margin-top:1rem;display:inline-block;color:var(--tx2);cursor:default;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--bd)}
/* skills */
#skills{background:var(--bg2)}
.sk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:2rem;margin-top:4rem}
.sk h3{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:1rem;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.sk ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.sk li{padding:.55rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--bd);color:var(--tx2);transition:color .3s,padding .3s;cursor:default}
.sk li:hover{color:var(--ac2);padding-left:.6rem}
/* journey */
.tl{margin-top:4rem;position:relative;padding-left:2.5rem;max-width:760px}
.tl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:6px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:var(--bd)}
.tl .fill{position:absolute;left:6px;top:0;width:1px;height:var(--p,0%);background:var(--ac)}
.it{position:relative;padding-bottom:3rem}
.it::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:calc(-2.5rem + 1px);top:.5rem;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--ac)}
.it h3{font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.it p{margin:0}
/* contact */
#contact{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.ring{position:absolute;right:-12vw;top:50%;width:48vw;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--bd);transform:translateY(-50%) scale(.4);opacity:0;transition:transform 2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),opacity 2s}
.ring.in{transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1);opacity:1}
.ring::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:14%;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ac);opacity:.5}
.soc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:0;margin-top:4rem;max-width:900px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd);position:relative;z-index:1}
.soc div{padding:1.2rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}
.soc b{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--tx)}.soc span{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--tx2)}
footer{padding:2rem 5vw;color:var(--tx2);font-size:.85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
/* cursor */
.cur{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:14px;height:14px;margin:-7px 0 0 -7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac2);pointer-events:none;z-index:99;transition:width .3s,height .3s,margin .3s,background .3s;display:none;mix-blend-mode:difference}
.cur.big{width:54px;height:54px;margin:-27px 0 0 -27px;background:#fff}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.cur{display:block}body.cx,body.cx a,body.cx button{cursor:none}}
@media (max-width:860px){
 section{padding:6rem 6vw}.links{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--bg);flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding:0 6vw;gap:1.2rem}
 .links.open{display:flex}.links a{font:800 2.4rem var(--d);color:var(--tx)}.ind{display:none}.burger{display:block;position:relative;z-index:60}
 .cols,.stage-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sk{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.meta{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.stage{position:static}.hint{display:none}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition-duration:.01ms!important}.ring{transition:none}}

:root{--e:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .9s var(--e),transform .9s var(--e);transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0)*90ms)}
.js .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.js #journey .rv{transform:translateX(-30px)}.js #skills .rv{transform:translateY(46px) scale(.97);transition-duration:1.1s}.js #contact .rv{transform:scale(.96)}
.js #journey .rv.in,.js #skills .rv.in,.js #contact .rv.in{transform:none}
.js h2:not(.in) .ch{opacity:0}
#about .cols{gap:1.2rem}
#about .cols>div{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 0fr;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:14px;padding:1.6rem 1.8rem;background:transparent;cursor:default;transition:opacity .9s var(--e),transform .9s var(--e),border-color .4s,background .5s,grid-template-rows .6s var(--e);transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0)*90ms),calc(var(--i,0)*90ms),0s,0s,0s}
#about .cols>div h3{margin:0;font-size:1.5rem;transition:color .4s,margin .5s var(--e)}
#about .cols>div p{margin:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .35s,transform .5s var(--e)}
#about .cols>div.open,#about .cols>div:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ac);background:var(--el);grid-template-rows:auto 1fr}
#about .cols>div.open h3,#about .cols>div:focus-visible h3{color:var(--ac2);margin-bottom:.8rem}
#about .cols>div.open p,#about .cols>div:focus-visible p{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:opacity .6s .1s,transform .7s .1s var(--e)}
#about .cols>div{align-self:start}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){html{scroll-behavior:smooth}}
.ring{pointer-events:none}
.mh{position:relative}.mh .l2{position:absolute;inset:0;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px var(--ac2);pointer-events:none;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle 150px at var(--mx,-999px) var(--my,-999px),#000 0,#000 55%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle 150px at var(--mx,-999px) var(--my,-999px),#000 0,#000 55%,transparent 100%)}
.js .hw>span{display:inline-block;transform:translateY(112%);transition:transform 1.1s var(--e);transition-delay:calc(var(--i)*70ms)}
.js h2.in .hw>span{transform:none}
section::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:5vw;right:5vw;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ac),var(--bd) 40%);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 1.6s var(--e)}
section.in::before{transform:scaleX(1)}#hero::before{display:none}
.pbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;width:100%;background:var(--ac);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(0);z-index:60}
.links a{position:relative}.btn{transition:transform .2s,background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}.btn:active,.sb:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.card{container-type:inline-size;clip-path:inset(0 round 6px);transition:transform .25s ease-out,clip-path 1.2s var(--e)}
.js .card.pre{clip-path:inset(9% 9% 9% 9% round 6px)}
.card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--sx,50%) var(--sy,50%),rgba(255,255,255,.13),transparent 45%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}.card:hover::after{opacity:1}
.art>*{transition:transform .8s var(--e)}.card:hover .art.on>*{transform:scale(1.035)}
.badge{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;z-index:3;font-size:.75rem;padding:.25rem .7rem;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:99px;background:rgba(8,9,13,.7);color:var(--tx2)}
.cap{display:none}
.pinfo h3{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.4rem);margin-top:1.6rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.lp{width:86%;background:#0b0d12;border:1px solid #2a2e3d;border-radius:1.4cqw;padding:1cqw;box-shadow:0 3cqw 6cqw rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.lp .sc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:17% 1fr;gap:1cqw;height:45cqw}.lp aside{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.2cqw;padding:1cqw;background:var(--el);border-radius:.8cqw}
.lp aside i{height:1.4cqw;border-radius:1cqw;background:var(--bd)}.lp aside i:first-child{background:var(--ac);width:60%}
.lp main{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto;gap:1cqw}.lp .st{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1cqw}.lp .st b{height:6cqw;border-radius:.8cqw;background:var(--el);border-top:.4cqw solid var(--ac2)}.lp .st b:nth-child(2){border-color:var(--ac)}
.lp .mp{border-radius:.8cqw;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%,var(--ac) 0 .8cqw,transparent .9cqw),radial-gradient(circle at 62% 62%,var(--ac2) 0 .8cqw,transparent .9cqw),radial-gradient(circle at 78% 30%,var(--ac) 0 .8cqw,transparent .9cqw),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#151821 0 3cqw,#12151c 3cqw 6cqw)}
.lp .rw{display:grid;gap:.8cqw}.lp .rw i{height:3cqw;border-radius:.8cqw;background:var(--el)}
.ph2{width:24%;aspect-ratio:9/18;background:#0b0d12;border:.4cqw solid #2a2e3d;border-radius:3cqw;padding:1cqw;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.9cqw;box-shadow:0 2cqw 4cqw rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.ph2:nth-child(2){transform:translateY(-5%)}.ph2 s{height:.8cqw;width:40%;margin:0 auto;border-radius:1cqw;background:var(--bd)}
.ph2 u{flex:1;border-radius:2cqw;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--ac),#2a2e42)}.ph2 u+u{flex:.8;background:var(--el)}.ph2 u+u+u{flex:.5;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--ac2),#1f2a2e)}
.ap{width:88%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:22% 1fr;background:#0b0d12;border:1px solid #2a2e3d;border-radius:1.4cqw;overflow:hidden;height:50cqw}.ap aside{background:var(--el);padding:1.4cqw;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.4cqw}
.ap .av{height:4.4cqw;border-radius:1cqw;background:var(--bd)}.ap .av:first-child{background:rgba(139,124,255,.35)}
.th{padding:1.6cqw;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.2cqw}.th i{height:4cqw;border-radius:2cqw;background:var(--el);width:50%}.th i:nth-child(2n){align-self:flex-end;background:var(--ac)}.th i:nth-child(3){width:68%}.cm{margin-top:auto;height:4cqw;border-radius:2cqw;border:1px solid var(--bd)}
.bd{width:88%;height:58cqw;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr auto;gap:1.4cqw}
.sp{grid-row:1/3;border-radius:1.4cqw;background:var(--el);display:grid;place-items:center;font:800 24cqw/1 var(--d);letter-spacing:-.05em}
.mk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1cqw}.mk b{border-radius:1cqw;background:var(--el);display:grid;place-items:center}.mk b::after{content:"";width:40%;aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--ac2);border-radius:50% 0 50% 0}
.mk b:nth-child(2)::after{background:var(--ac);border-radius:50%}.mk b:nth-child(3)::after{background:var(--tx);border-radius:0 50%}.mk b:nth-child(4)::after{background:var(--ac);transform:rotate(45deg);border-radius:0}
.sw{display:flex;gap:1cqw}.sw i{flex:1;height:7cqw;border-radius:1cqw}.sw i:nth-child(1){background:#8B7CFF}.sw i:nth-child(2){background:#63D9CE}.sw i:nth-child(3){background:#F4F4F5}.sw i:nth-child(4){background:#171A22;border:1px solid var(--bd)}.sw i:nth-child(5){background:#9296A2}
.ex{position:relative;width:80%;height:58cqw}.ex i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;mix-blend-mode:screen;aspect-ratio:1}.ex i:nth-child(1){left:4%;top:6%;width:56%;background:var(--ac)}.ex i:nth-child(2){right:4%;bottom:8%;width:50%;background:var(--ac2)}.ex i:nth-child(3){left:32%;top:28%;width:34%;border:.6cqw solid var(--tx)}
.ex u{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-2cqw;font:800 11cqw var(--d);text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:-.05em}
.an{width:88%}.an .fr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:1cqw}.an b{aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:1cqw;background:var(--el);border:1px solid var(--bd);position:relative}
.an b::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:34%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac2);left:calc(8% + var(--n)*9%);top:calc(60% - var(--n)*12%);opacity:calc(.35 + var(--n)*.16)}
.an b:nth-child(2){--n:1}.an b:nth-child(3){--n:2}.an b:nth-child(4){--n:3}.an b:nth-child(5){--n:4}

  <p class="id">UI/UX Designer · Visual Designer · Creative Thinker</p>
  <p class="sub">I turn ideas into thoughtful digital experiences through design, experimentation, and creative problem-solving.</p>
  <div class="row"><a class="btn p" href="#works">Explore my work</a><a class="btn" href="#contact">Let’s connect</a></div>

<section id="about">
 <h2>Curiosity drives everything I create.</h2>
 <p class="big">I’m a designer interested in creating intuitive, meaningful, and visually refined digital experiences.</p>
 <div class="cols">
  <div><h3>Design philosophy</h3><p>I believe good design is not just about how things look, but how naturally they work. Every detail should have a purpose, every interaction should feel intuitive, and every experience should make life a little easier. For me, simplicity, clarity, and thoughtful decisions are at the heart of meaningful design.</p></div>
  <div><h3>Creative approach</h3><p>I start by understanding the problem, the people behind it, and what the experience needs to achieve. From research and exploring ideas to wireframing, visual design, and prototyping, I approach each step with curiosity and intention. I enjoy experimenting, refining details, and turning complex ideas into simple, functional experiences.</p></div>
  <div><h3>What I enjoy exploring</h3><p>I’m always curious about the intersection of design, technology, and creativity. I enjoy exploring product design, visual identities, typography, motion design, interactive experiences, and emerging creative tools. I’m particularly interested in how small details and thoughtful interactions can make digital products feel more engaging.</p></div>
  <div><h3>A short introduction</h3><p>I’m Anay Ghosh, a UI/UX and visual designer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I enjoy turning ideas into meaningful digital experiences through thoughtful design and creative exploration. I’m continuously learning, experimenting, and developing my skills with the goal of creating work that is both useful and visually distinctive.</p></div>
 </div>
</section>

  <div class="it rv"><div class="dt"><b>April 2025 to present</b>Full time</div><div class="bd2"><h3>UI/UX Designer</h3><p>Antripe</p><span class="dur" id="dur"></span>
   <p style="color:var(--tx2);margin-top:1rem">I design interfaces and visual content at Antripe, from product screens to marketing graphics, turning ideas into clear, polished designs that work for both users and the brand.</p>
   <h4>Responsibilities</h4><ul><li>UI Design</li><li>UX Design</li><li>CodeCanyon Design</li><li>Thumbnail Design</li><li>Social Media Post Design</li></ul>
   <h4>Key contributions</h4><ul><li>Designed clean, user-friendly interfaces and flows for web and mobile products.</li><li>Created CodeCanyon-ready design assets that present products clearly to buyers.</li><li>Produced consistent thumbnails and social media posts that keep the brand visually cohesive.</li></ul>
   <h4>Design skills</h4><p style="margin:0">UI/UX Design, Graphics Design, Social Media Post Design</p>
   <h4>Tools</h4><p style="margin:0">Figma, Adobe Illustrator</p></div></div>
